caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #2: PROCLIVITY

proclivity (noun): a natural tendency to do something.

✅ In a sentence: Cats have a proclivity for knocking things off tables.
✅ Similar: tendency, inclination, propensity
✅ Remember it: pro- (forward) + clivus (slope): leaning toward.
